risks.note: The MD&A states the business strategy is largely dependent on the economic environment of the country and that any slowdown of economic growth could adversely affect the Company's performance, leaving earnings exposed to a cycle the Company does not control.
risks.risk: Macro dependence — business strategy tied to the country's economic environment

risks.note: With one of only two segments being 'Treasury Operations' in shares and securities of other bodies corporate, volatility in the financial market could adversely affect performance; management attributes the year's weaker ratios to lower contribution from investment-related income streams and negative returns on disposal of financial assets.
risks.risk: Financial-market volatility on the treasury book

risks.note: Income comprised mainly revenue from trading activities, investments, royalty and dividend from Joint Ventures across just two segments ('Treasury Operations' and 'Trading activities'), so earnings quality depends on income streams outside a core manufacturing operation.

The Company wrote off its investment in subsidiary Twelve Cupcakes Pte. Ltd., Singapore pursuant to its liquidation process, a one-time exceptional write-off of a foreign subsidiary that management cites as a driver of the decline in returns.
Management continues to review the business strategy from time to time depending on changes in Government policies, indicating policy shifts can force strategy resets.

The subsidiary's Jammu project saw temporary disruption of activities due to the geo-political situation before restarting, showing commissioning timelines for the BOPP lines are exposed to events outside management control.
Management describes it as a challenging business that may take some time to witness a significant improvement in market conditions, which delays the payback on the group's film capacity.

The MD&A cautionary statement flags a downtrend in the industry, global or domestic or both, significant changes in the political and economic environment in India, applicable statutes and litigation as developments that could affect operations.
risks.risk: Industry downturn and regulatory/litigation environment (cautionary statement)
